blocks.text: Canadian singer-songwriter Alanis Morissette got candid about her sexuality as she admitted that she identifies as a pansexual. The 52-year-old musician shared the revelation in the recent episode of the “Handsome” podcast hosted by comedians Tig Notaro, Fortune Feimster and Mae Martin. The conversation turned to Morissette’s relationships after Feimster praised the singer for turning her painful experiences with men into memorable songs. “I’m sorry for the men that hurt you, but I’m not sorry for the songs that came from it. Those are pretty amazing,” Feimster told Morissette before asking whether those experiences had ever made her “want to be […]...
